infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: OneShort uses your approximate location to rank players and find matches, teams and communities near you. Your exact location is never shared.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: OneShort uses the camera only when you choose to take a profile photo or a team photo.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: OneShort opens your photo library only when you choose a profile photo or a team photo. Nothing else is read.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: OneShort uses your approximate location to rank players and find matches, teams and communities near you. Your exact location is never shared.

plugins.photosPermission: OneShort opens your photo library only when you choose a profile photo or a team photo. Nothing else is read.
plugins.cameraPermission: OneShort uses the camera only when you choose to take a profile photo or a team photo.

plugins.microphonePermission: OneShort uses the microphone only while you search by voice. Audio isn't recorded or stored.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: OneShort turns what you say into search text, e.g. 'I want to play on Saturday morning'.
